title: Cheap production can expand review and selection work
text: The essay describes how more accessible execution changes the work of deciding what matters, judging the result and carrying responsibility. This is useful for capacity planning: additional drafts or code are not automatically additional accepted output when review, prioritisation or distribution remains constrained.
qualification: Conceptual and first-party account. No causal estimate of reviewer burden or universal labour outcome is established.
